# 🐷 PORK Landing Page

💼 **Commercial Project**

🔗 Live Demo: https://pashko911.github.io/pork

---

## ✨ About

**PORK** is a promotional landing page for a meme token project built around a bold and playful pig-themed concept.

The website combines strong visual storytelling with a presale-focused interface, allowing users to explore the project, view the roadmap, and interact with a token purchase widget.

The design emphasizes dynamic animations, engaging UI elements, and a conversion-oriented structure tailored for Web3 audiences.

---

## 🚀 Features

- 🎨 Custom UI/UX with strong character-driven branding
- 📱 Fully responsive layout
- ⚡ Optimized performance (PageSpeed 90+)
- 🎞️ Rich animations and visual effects
- 🧠 Scroll-based appearance animations (watcher system)
- 💰 Token presale widget (ETH / USDT switch)
- 🔗 Wallet interaction UI (connect flow)
- 📊 Interactive input fields for token calculation
- 📋 Copy-to-clipboard functionality
- 🗺️ Roadmap section with structured phases
- 💸 “How to Buy” step-by-step guide

---

## 🛠️ Technologies Used

- HTML5
- SCSS (Sass)
- JavaScript (ES6+)
- Gulp
- Web3 UI logic (wallet interaction)
